## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (backend, frontend or E2E as appropriate)
- [ ] `ruff check backend tests` and `ruff format --check backend tests` pass
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run test`, `npm run build` pass
- [ ] Database changes include an Alembic migration and were tested on SQLite and PostgreSQL
- [ ] Responsive layout checked at 390 px and desktop widths
- [ ] Privacy/security implications reviewed (authorization, EXIF, third-party calls)
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` updated
- [ ] No secrets, personal photos or build artefacts committed
